verdict.rationale: kitty documents startup sessions to 'specify working environments' (tabs, splits, layouts). A user confirms that default startup tabs are easy to set up via session files, though those files are barely documented. This lets a developer recreate a predeclared set of windows and tabs at launch, but nothing shows kitty saving and restoring the live state after a restart or crash. Missing for 10: automatic capture of current windows/tabs/cwd, crash recovery, documented working-directory restoration, in-depth session docs.
